name: Supreme x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Box Logo - Baroque Brown'
story_html: The Supreme x Nike Air Force 1 Low ‘Box Logo’ steps out in ‘Baroque Brown.’ Made exclusively for the New York skate brand, the iconic silhouette dons a smooth leather upper in a monochromatic brown finish, contrasted by a red Supreme box logo on the lateral heel. Dual Nike and Supreme branding adorns the tongue tag and sockliner. The sneaker rests on a color-matched rubber cupsole, featuring encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the heel and a pivot-point rubber outsole underfoot.
